title: Semantic Search Benchmark Database — Overview and definition
body: Signature edition. Original Signature methods, framings, and analyses developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout; never mixed with public-harvest records. Queries, relevance judgments, retrieval scores, and search-quality comparisons. The Semantic Search Benchmark Database measures whether search actually finds what matters: standard query sets, human relevance judgments, scoring metrics, and head-to-head comparisons of retrieval methods. Keyword search, embedding search, and hybrid approaches all claim to be best — this database makes them prove it on the same queries with the same judgments, so 'better search' is a measured fact, not a slogan.

title: Semantic Search Benchmark Database — Knowledge: technical reference
body: Signature edition. Original Signature methods, framings, and analyses developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout; never mixed with public-harvest records. Metrics. Precision@k = relevant in top-k / k. Recall = retrieved relevant / total relevant. MRR = mean over queries of 1/rank(first relevant). NDCG@k = DCG@k / IDCG@k with DCG@k = sum_{i=1..k} (2^{rel_i}-1)/log2(i+1). Methods: BM25 keyword scoring (term frequency saturated, length-normalized); dense retrieval (query/doc embeddings, cosine similarity, ANN index); hybrid (score fusion, e.g. 0.4*BM25_norm + 0.6*dense). Judgment: graded relevance 0-3 by guidelines; inter-annotator agreement reported (Cohen's kappa). Failure classes: vocabulary mismatch, negation, multi-hop, freshness — each method's weakness profile is recorded.

demo.code: function jw(a,b){a=a.toLowerCase();b=b.toLowerCase();if(a===b)return 1;let m=0;const n=Math.min(a.length,b.length);for(let i=0;i<n;i++)if(a[i]===b[i])m++;return m/Math.max(a.length,b.length);}const pairs=[['Jon Smith','John Smith'],['Jon Smith','Maria Garcia']];const scored=pairs.map(([x,y])=>({x,y,s:+jw(x,y).toFixed(2)}));J({scored});assert(scored[0].s>scored[1].s,'match');

title: Semantic Search Benchmark Database — Verification: tests and limitations
body: Signature edition. Original Signature methods, framings, and analyses developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout; never mixed with public-harvest records. Tests: metric test (hand-computed examples match to 1e-9); comparison test (same inputs, same scores); judgment test (disagreement above threshold flags the query); determinism test. Limitations: small benchmarks are noisy — report confidence intervals; judgments age as content changes. Benchmarks carry version numbers and judgment dates.

demo.title: Execution: pipeline stage hashing and replay
demo.code: const crypto=require('crypto');function h(s){return crypto.createHash('sha256').update(s).digest('hex').slice(0,8);}const stages=['import','clean','validate','export'];const data='raw-data-v1';let cur=data;const hashes=stages.map(s=>{cur=s+':'+cur;return s+'='+h(cur);});const replay=(()=>{let c=data;return stages.map(s=>{c=s+':'+c;return s+'='+h(c);});})();J({hashes:hashes.length,replayMatch:JSON.stringify(hashes)===JSON.stringify(replay)});assert(JSON.stringify(hashes)===JSON.stringify(replay),'replay');
